title: Spaghetti with Roasted Brussels Sprouts, Mushrooms, Walnuts & Parmesan

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, and quarter mushrooms. Add to the baking sheet with the Brussels sprouts.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and maple syrup, then season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and walnuts are toasted, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the pasta is done, reserve ⅔-cup of cooking water, then drain. Return pasta and reserved cooking water to the pot; set aside until the veggies are done.

Add roasted veggies, walnuts, Parmesan, and Dijon to the pot, then set over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring often, until the liquid has evaporated and Parmesan has melted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
